actions.new_text: Jesus is named as the one who knows the thoughts of others in Mat 9:4, Mat 12:25, Luk 5:22 and Luk 6:8, and as the one who asks the hearer's thought in Mat 17:25 and Mat 22:42; in Joh 11:13 and Joh 13:29 others mistake his meaning, and in Joh 11:56 they wonder whether he will come; in Mat 22:16 and Mar 12:14 he is said not to regard appearances, and in Joh 5:45 Moses is named as the accuser.
